reviewer: agent build pass (headless Chrome verify-first probe + route-complete acceptance validator, desktop 1280×800 + mobile 360×740 DPR3)

rubric.evidence: Verify-first probe BEFORE building (headless Chrome, dynamic import of the pinned CDN @huggingface/transformers@3.7.5, Xenova/distilbert-base-uncased q8 WASM): pipeline('fill-mask') loaded and 'The capital of France is [MASK].' returned real top-5 fills (marseille 0.1315, paris 0.1048, nantes 0.0820, lille 0.0644, lyon 0.0631); raw AutoModelForMaskedLM logits [1,9,30522] float32 — PROBE_PASS (scratchpad/probe-distilbert-fill-mask.mjs). Acceptance validator then drove real inference on all 4 routes × desktop+mobile.

AutoModelForMaskedLM returns logits [1, seq, 30522]; the page slices the row at each [MASK] position and softmaxes it itself. Probe: top-5 for 'The capital of France is [MASK].' are all French cities decoded from the 30,522-token uncased WordPiece vocab.

At-a-glance declares model id (Xenova/distilbert-base-uncased, ONNX build of distilbert/distilbert-base-uncased), task fill-mask, q8 quantisation, WASM backend, ~67 MB. Literal model id at the loader call site and in worker.js (MODEL_ID).

All four routes load via lib/model-loader.js createModelLoader (backed by lib/model-cache.js): first visit shows an honest Download (~67 MB); a cached current copy auto-initialises with no Load click; per-model clear-cache control from the shared loader.

Shared loader streams download progress and offers Retry; #runStatus (role=status aria-live) reports 'add a [MASK]', empty-candidate, and inference failures with .err on the page; WASM path runs with no GPU.

Every visible control is keyboard-operable and labelled: sample chips (buttons in a labelled group), sentence input with associated <label>, Insert-[MASK] button, top-k slider with live value, clickable prediction rows (buttons) on overview/basics, candidate input + Score button + template chips on practical, set <select> + Run-batch button on wild.
Predictions, logits, entropy, candidate scores, and proverb completions are all produced by the on-device worker run (probe + acceptance validator evidence); nothing is canned.
Labelled controls, role=status aria-live status regions, prediction rows are real buttons, shared loader's live region; design-system colours (WCAG AA, light+dark) only.
Acceptance validator asserted no horizontal overflow at desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3 on all four routes; prediction grid collapses (logit column hidden) under 560px; chips wrap.
Inference + the 30,522-token softmax run in a module worker; typing debounced (350 ms; 500 ms for candidate scoring); the page only renders returned top-k rows.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Accessible form controls with clear, associated labels; don't rely on placeholder.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: applied — sentence and candidate inputs have associated <label> elements; chips and the set selector are labelled; slider labelled with a live value readout.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: npx -y modern-web-guidance@latest search "accessible form controls with labels and live region status for async model loading" (2026-07-27) returned forms@0.637 as the top hit; run-panel markup on all four routes.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Label controls; announce state in a live region; keyboard-operable.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: applied — every control labelled; #runStatus role=status aria-live announces guidance/errors; prediction rows keyboard-activatable buttons.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce dynamic errors in an aria-live region on the page, not only the console.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: applied — missing-mask, empty-candidate, and inference failures render in the aria-live #runStatus with an .err class.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: same guidance search (accessible-error-announcement@0.382); run handlers on all routes.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Offload / break up long main-thread tasks.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: applied — the masked-LM forward pass + full-vocabulary softmax run in worker.js off the main thread; UI renders only the returned top-k.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: search "web worker off main thread long tasks INP" (break-up-long-tasks@0.568); worker.js; debounced inputs; acceptance validator 0 console errors while interacting.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep INP low — keep heavy JS off the interaction path.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: applied — inference off-thread, 350–500 ms debounce on text inputs, batch probe runs sequentially in the worker.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: worker.js + fillmask.js debounce; readout latency surfaced per run.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Responsive flex/grid layout without fixed widths that overflow narrow viewports; let content wrap.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: applied — flex-wrap chips, prediction grid collapses columns under 560px, validator asserts zero horizontal overflow at 360px.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: FILLMASK_CSS media query; search "responsive layout mobile no horizontal overflow tap targets" (css-layout@0.489); acceptance validator no-horizontal-overflow checks at both viewports.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Cross-document view transitions for catalogue↔page nav.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: applied — @view-transition navigation:auto in the shared public/styles.css.

followUpGoals.goal: Add a WebGPU execution-provider fast path for distilbert-base-uncased (honest WASM fallback retained) as an additive enhancement.

summary: Canonical DistilBERT-base-uncased fill-mask (Xenova/distilbert-base-uncased, q8 WASM) — BERT-base distilled to 6 layers / ~66M params — with overview (raw-logit see-inside + entropy), basics, practical candidate-scoring, and a wild batch proverb probe; verify-first probe passed before the build; all loading via the shared createModelLoader; inference in a module worker.
